description:
You are the instructor for BIO302 Advanced Cell Biology at State University. Set up a complete student progression tracking system for the course.

1. For each activity, configure the appropriate completion condition:
   - 'Lab Safety and Ethics Module': mark complete when student views it
   - 'Cell Membrane Transport Lab': mark complete when student submits
   - 'Molecular Biology Quiz': mark complete when student achieves a passing grade (70% or higher)
   - 'Research Discussion Forum': mark complete when student makes a post
   - 'Final Research Report': mark complete when student submits

2. Configure the BIO302 course completion criteria so that a student completes the course only when ALL five activities above are marked as complete.

3. Create a course badge called 'Advanced Cell Biology Scholar' with the description 'Awarded to students who successfully complete all BIO302 Advanced Cell Biology course requirements including laboratory work, assessments, and discussions.' Set the badge criteria to course completion (students must complete BIO302). Set the badge to expire 3 years after it is issued.

Login: admin / Admin1234!
